figurative_meaning_en: The auspicious and inauspicious lines on the palm resembling leprosy marks
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার করকুষ্ঠি দেখে বলা গেল যে সে ধনী হবে।
করকুষ্ঠি দেখানোর অভ্যাস তার ছিল না।
example_sentences_in_english: From reading his palm lines, it was said he would become wealthy.
He had no habit of showing his palm lines.
note: Refers to palmistry practices common in Bengali folklore
